schemaVersion.description: Generator schema version, always the component id.

title.description: Short title for students in plain text.

id.description: Lowercase kebab card id, 40 characters or fewer.

stem.description: Question stem in plain text, 10 to 160 characters. Must not reveal the answer.

items.description: One answer option in plain text, 1 to 80 characters. The first option is the correct answer.

sourceId.description: Id of the source the quote was copied from.

quote.description: Exact characters copied from the source, no ellipsis, 150 characters or fewer. The first option occurs in this quote.

hint.description: Hint in plain text, empty string or 5 to 120 characters.
